AcceptanceDecision.description:
One stage outcome of one candidate against one pipeline (R17).

Rejection totals reconcile exactly with candidate counts in the owning
store.
AcceptanceDecision.title: AcceptanceDecision

AcceptancePipeline.description:
Ordered acceptance pipeline definition (R16).

Higher-cost stages receive only candidates allowed by earlier stages.
AcceptancePipeline.title: AcceptancePipeline

AcceptanceStage.description: One ordered stage of a research acceptance pipeline.
AcceptanceStage.title: AcceptanceStage

AiImprovementProposal.description:
Governed AI improvement proposal over one parent strategy (R22).

Experimental: proposals may not run, promote, overwrite, or delete
strategies without an explicit approved research action.
AiImprovementProposal.title: AiImprovementProposal

AiResearchDraft.description:
Redacted AI-drafted strategy proposal (R21, experimental).

Proposed ASTs pass the same registry/schema validation as the editor and
are never executable by themselves; AI inputs are minimized and redacted,
and disabling the adapter leaves all stable workflows functional.
AiResearchDraft.title: AiResearchDraft

AssistResearchAiRequest.description:
Operation-discriminated AI-assisted research request.

Experimental gating: an external AI failure never impairs non-AI
workflows.
AssistResearchAiRequest.title: AssistResearchAiRequest

BuilderPlan.description:
Reproducible Builder strategy-generation search manifest (R13).

The complete search is reproducible from this one manifest; only
type-valid strategies satisfying grammar, resource, complexity, and
required-block constraints are emitted, and semantic duplicates are
detected by normalized fingerprints with a declared collision policy.
BuilderPlan.title: BuilderPlan

DriftReport.description: Pinned expectancy versus later evidence drift report (R27).
DriftReport.title: DriftReport

DriftState.description:
Advisory drift classification of one subject at one instant (R26).

Advisory until a separate acceptance or Risk policy consumes it.
DriftState.title: DriftState

EvolutionPlan.description:
Genetic-evolution configuration with checkpointable RNG streams (R15).

Checkpoints contain generation/island populations, fitness, the duplicate
index, counters, and every named RNG stream state; resuming after each
checkpoint reproduces identical evolution.
EvolutionPlan.title: EvolutionPlan

EvolveStrategiesRequest.description: Operation-discriminated Improver and genetic evolution request.
EvolveStrategiesRequest.title: EvolveStrategiesRequest

EvolveStrategiesSuccess.description: Successful Improver and genetic evolution operation result.
EvolveStrategiesSuccess.title: EvolveStrategiesSuccess

ExpressionNode.description:
One typed operator application over referenced operand nodes.

Domain assumption: invalid operand connections such as series-to-boolean
or price-to-duration require the operand types from the block catalogue,
so they are rejected by AST validation (FR-STRAT-DEFINE_AST_TYPES) rather
than by this wire shape.
ExpressionNode.title: ExpressionNode

GovernResearchBudgetsSuccess.description: Successful research budget governance operation result.
GovernResearchBudgetsSuccess.title: GovernResearchBudgetsSuccess

InstrumentRef.description: Reference to one canonical instrument identity.
InstrumentRef.title: InstrumentRef

MarketIntelligenceObservation.description:
Immutable point-in-time market intelligence study output (R25).

Consumes only Data-owned point-in-time evidence; descriptive evidence is
distinguished from executable rules through versioned definitions.
MarketIntelligenceObservation.title: MarketIntelligenceObservation

MarketMatrixCell.description: One pinned market/broker/data-version cell of a retest market matrix.
MarketMatrixCell.title: MarketMatrixCell

MonitorMarketDriftRequest.description: Operation-discriminated market intelligence and drift request.
MonitorMarketDriftRequest.title: MonitorMarketDriftRequest

MonitorMarketDriftSuccess.description: Successful market intelligence and drift operation result.
MonitorMarketDriftSuccess.title: MonitorMarketDriftSuccess

MonteCarloSpec.description: Seeded Monte Carlo perturbation specification of a robustness plan.
MonteCarloSpec.title: MonteCarloSpec

NeuralResearchPlan.description: Neural research training/inference artifact plan (R23, experimental).
NeuralResearchPlan.title: NeuralResearchPlan

NodeBinding.description:
One typed input binding of an AST node.

Domain assumption: exactly one of ``source_node_id`` and a ``constant``
value supplies a port; the mutual-exclusion rule is enforced by AST
normalization (FR-STRAT-DEFINE_AST_NODES), not by the wire shape, because
a ``None`` constant is itself a legal JSON value.
NodeBinding.title: NodeBinding

OptimizationPlan.description:
Admitted parameter-optimization plan (R7).

Admission reports the projected evaluation count and storage; over-policy
domains reject unless budget-limited, duplicate vectors execute at most
once per compatible manifest, and replay selects the same final vector.
OptimizationPlan.title: OptimizationPlan

OptimizationResult.description: Ranked variants and selection of one optimization run (R9).
OptimizationResult.title: OptimizationResult

OptimizationVariant.description: One evaluated parameter vector of an optimization run (R8).
OptimizationVariant.title: OptimizationVariant

PortfolioFitnessScore.description:
Portfolio-aware Builder fitness score of one candidate (R24).

Phase 3 Builder option; only a caller-supplied immutable pinned portfolio
version is accepted, so Research never depends on Portfolio runtime.
PortfolioFitnessScore.title: PortfolioFitnessScore

PromotionDecision.description:
Immutable promotion of one candidate into a new strategy version (R19).

Promotion creates a new immutable strategy version linked to its source
candidate and result; it never overwrites parents, so lineage stays
traversable afterwards.
PromotionDecision.title: PromotionDecision

ResearchBudget.description:
Bound set enforced by research budget governance.

Public record R18, defined ahead of the table order because
``ResearchManifest`` (R2) embeds it; every bound left ``None`` is
unbounded, and bound exhaustion is a runtime policy, not a record rule.
ResearchBudget.title: ResearchBudget

ResearchFailure.description: Structured failure envelope shared by every research capability.
ResearchFailure.title: ResearchFailure

ResearchManifest.description:
Immutable pinned inputs of one research execution request (R2).

Equivalent requests from every entry point produce one manifest
``content_hash``; the approved preview hash must match at admission.
ResearchManifest.title: ResearchManifest

ResearchRunRef.description:
Reference to one controllable research run execution (R1).

Start/pause/resume/stop/cancel/status commands are idempotent; repeated
commands create one effective transition. That runtime contract is
enforced by the owning feature, not by this record.
ResearchRunRef.title: ResearchRunRef

ResearchStatus.description:
Bounded observational progress snapshot of one research run (R3).

Failed runs retain the classified error, checkpoint sequence, committed
partial artifacts, and retry eligibility so failure pages never require
log parsing.
ResearchStatus.title: ResearchStatus

RobustnessPlan.description:
Pinned retest and robustness execution plan (R4).

Input membership cannot change mid-run, every candidate yields an
accepted result or a structured rejection, and simulation ordinal 0
reproduces the baseline; those are runtime contracts of the owning
feature.
RobustnessPlan.title: RobustnessPlan

RobustnessResult.description: Aggregated robustness simulation outcomes for one plan (R5).
RobustnessResult.title: RobustnessResult

RobustnessSimulation.description: One ordinal robustness simulation sample or its structured failure.
RobustnessSimulation.title: RobustnessSimulation

RunResearchRequest.description:
Operation-discriminated manual research run request.

The ratified v1 envelope spells only the operation set; per-operation
request payloads beyond the common fields remain owned by the feature
admission rules rather than this frozen wire record.
RunResearchRequest.title: RunResearchRequest

RunResearchSuccess.description: Successful manual research run operation result.
RunResearchSuccess.title: RunResearchSuccess

SequentialStage.description: One sequential optimization stage over one parameter.
SequentialStage.title: SequentialStage

SeriesInterval.description:
Half-open UTC interval `[from_at, to_at)`.

The interval must be positive; half-open interval semantics follow
Project §15.4 and apply to every data interval record.
SeriesInterval.title: SeriesInterval

SpaceDimension.description: One named dimension of a parameter space.
SpaceDimension.title: SpaceDimension

StockpickerResearchPlan.description:
Point-in-time stockpicker research plan (R20).

Repeated runs select identical historical constituents.
StockpickerResearchPlan.title: StockpickerResearchPlan

StrategyAst.description:
Canonical typed abstract syntax tree of one strategy.

Commutatively reordered AND operands hash equally; ordered action
sequences do not (FR-STRAT-NORMALIZE_STRATEGY_AST).
StrategyAst.title: StrategyAst

StrategyCandidate.description: One generated or evolved strategy candidate with exact lineage (R14).
StrategyCandidate.title: StrategyCandidate

StrategyNode.description: One AST node carrying identity, block reference, and typed bindings.
StrategyNode.title: StrategyNode

StrategyValidationReport.description:
Complete validation findings for one strategy version.

The response contains all findings covering structure, types, block
versions, parameter domains, charts, instruments, sessions, data
precision, order lifecycle, sizing, exits, and the selected code target
(FR-STRAT-VALIDATE_STRATEGIES).
StrategyValidationReport.title: StrategyValidationReport

TestRobustnessSuccess.description: Successful retest and robustness operation result.
TestRobustnessSuccess.title: TestRobustnessSuccess

WalkForwardPlan.description:
Walk-forward window scheme and evaluation policy (R10).

No timestamp overlap violating the scheme and selection-only data
visibility are runtime contracts enforced while windows execute.
WalkForwardPlan.title: WalkForwardPlan

WalkForwardResult.description: Stitched walk-forward windows and aggregate metrics (R12).
WalkForwardResult.title: WalkForwardResult

WalkForwardWindow.title: WalkForwardWindow
